meta.name: excel-debug-extraction
meta.description: Iteratively debug Excel structure with exploratory scripts before writing extraction logic

copy.tagline: 用探索式脚本调试 Excel 结构后再写提取逻辑
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从复杂 Excel 中提取数据但总遇到结构问题
copy.tagline_en: Debug Excel structure with exploratory scripts before writing extraction logic
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often extract data from complex Excel files and encounter structural issues

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会先编写探索性脚本扫描Excel文件结构（如工作表、列位置、行模式），然后基于发现的结果再写出最终的提取逻辑，避免直接假设表格结构。
howto.when: 当你处理格式不统一、含有合并单元格的Excel文件，或来自外部来源结构不明的文件，以及复杂的多工作表工作簿等时触发。

say.text: 帮我调试这个Excel文件的结构
say.note: Claude会运行探索性脚本分析布局

say.text: 分析这个表格的列映射
say.note: Claude会检查表头并定位各列
Claude会分类各行类型并显示样本

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will first write exploratory scripts to scan the Excel file structure (sheets, columns, row patterns), then use findings to write the final extraction logic, avoiding assumptions about the structure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when handling Excel files with inconsistent formatting, merged cells, unknown structure from external sources, or complex multi-sheet workbooks.

say_en.text: Help me debug this Excel file's structure
say_en.note: Claude will run exploratory scripts to analyze layout

say_en.text: Analyze the column mapping of this sheet
say_en.note: Claude will inspect headers and locate each column

say_en.text: Find the row patterns in this data
say_en.note: Claude will classify row types and show samples
